messages:
Ellie: Quick sync  relnotes draft ready but need final snippet sweep and a couple of small known-issue callouts.
Omar: Send link?
Ellie: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/branches/relnotes-2655551234
Priya: Scanning now  I see the Python quickstart still uses `import redwood` old style. Need to update to `from redwood import Client` and mention minimum version.
Chen: I'll prepare both short and expanded snippets for the migration guide.
Nate: Found two broken links in the draft: `/how-to/caching` -> 404 and `/sdk/auth-old` -> 410. Docs Bot, can you run link-check on that branch?
Docs Bot: Link-check queued for relnotes-2655551234  results in ~2m :gear:
Omar: Also, product wants the fallback routing feature labeled "preview (opt-in)" not "beta". Marketing asked for that wording.
Ellie: Noted  will change language.
Priya: For the caching 404, suggest we add a brief inline snippet in the relnotes under "Performance tips" showing `client.cache.set(key, value)` so users have a quick reference while we fix the redirect.
Chen: Snippet for JS ESM and CJS added to draft: ```js
// ESM
import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'
const c = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
// CJS
const { Client } = require('@redwood/sdk')
const c2 = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
```
Nate: For the Python bit: ```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
```
Ellie: Good. Also need a short known-issue about embed streaming: partial event chunks can surface for some clients. Engineering suggested a temporary mitigation: reconnect after 25s idle. We'll include repro steps.
Priya: Paste repro here so I can use exact commands.
Chen: Repro (local): ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds/stream
# send two rapid inputs, then close socket after second chunk
```
Omar: Please add the internal tracker link: internal/issue/8244. Mark the workaround as temporary.
Ellie: Will add: "Temporary workaround: force reconnect on client after 25s of partial stream; tracked internally at internal/issue/8244."
Docs Bot: Link-check complete: two issues found (`/how-to/caching` 404, `/sdk/auth-old` 410). Redirect PR suggested to `/how-to/caching` -> `/how-to/caching-overview`.
Nate: I'll open the redirect PR and a tiny snippet PR for the Python import bump. PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5218 and /pull/5219
Priya: One last ask from support: include a migration note for Dedicated customers about `routing.preview=true` config flag and example.
Ellie: Added config example under "Deployment changes".
Omar: Marketing sign-off pending but ok with "preview (opt-in)" wording.
Ellie: Plan: Nate merges redirect + snippet PRs, Docs Bot verifies links, I update the relnotes branch with wording changes, then we merge and publish EOD if green.
Priya: I can do a final pass after Docs Bot green.
Chen: No blockers from engineering.
Nate: Redirect PR opened.
Docs Bot: Re-run link-check queued.
Ellie: Thanks all  ping here for any immediate fixes. :rocket:
